items.headline: NFL Week 5: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
items.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 5.

items.headline: Jared Goff, Jahmyr Gibbs lead the Lions' offensive romp in a 45-21 win over the Cardinals
items.description: — Jared Goff threw three touchdown passes, Jahmyr Gibbs added 151 yards rushing and two more scores and the Detroit Lions shook off a slow start by scoring 31 straight points to roll past the Arizona Cardinals 45-21 on Sunday.

items.headline: NFL Week 5 arrivals: Ravens trio channels early 2000s style ahead of 'SNF'
items.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

items.headline: What does trading for the Cardinals' Marvin Harrison Jr. mean for the Texans?
items.description: After a 1-4 start, Houston is bringing in Harrison in hopes of giving Stroud another playmaker.

items.headline: NFL trade deadline grades: Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans; Cam Jurgens to Ravens
items.description: Will Marvin Harrison Jr. boost Houston's offense? Can Cam Jurgens fill the Ravens' hole at center? We're grading NFL trades ahead of November's deadline.

items.headline: 2026 NFL trade deadline updates: Marvin Harrison Jr., Cam Jurgens on the move
items.description: The NFL trade deadline is Nov. 10, but deals have already started. We're tracking all moves, including the Cards sending Marvin Harrison Jr. to the Texans.
